blurb: Guests rent motorized boats and party barges for leisure, parties, and events on lakes such as Lake Lewisville and Lake Grapevine. Party boats have capacities from 20 to 100 passengers and offer amenities like bathrooms, bars, and sound systems. Rentals include life jackets and safety equipment; some boats come with captains.
extraNote: All rentals are non-refundable and do not allow cancellation · Rain checks issued only on date and location of rental; customers must appear at marina at reserved time · Fuel not included in rental costs; charged at Ship Store on rental day; fuel included in charter price · No docking of any watercraft with rented boats or party boats allowed · One reservation per person on all boats and wave runners; multiple vessels require separate reservations under different names · All gift card purchases are final and non-refundable. · CANCEL A RESERVATION All reservations and payments received are non-refundable. · Please do not contact them to request a rain check as they are not authorized to issue
